title: Functionalities of electronic routine health information systems related to newborn data: findings of the IMPULSE study in Uganda, Ethiopia, Tanzania, and the Central African Republic
why_not: Assesses DHIS2 functions at 7 data offices (6 district, 1 central) and says all districts were connected only in mid-2023: district-level digitisation, which is held; no fact on facility tiers or primary clinics.
